title: Business customers
statementMd:
List the names of customers in the `business` segment.

Expected columns: `name`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name FROM customers WHERE segment = 'business';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
